name: orb-duel-replay
description: Run the local duel verification (Node suites, build, Chrome replay of seed 0) and report the observed results.

steps.prompt: From the project root run `git rev-parse --short HEAD`, then `node scripts/verify-duel.mjs --browser` once. This step owns verification commands and the ignored outputs in .artifacts/kiro/replay only; edit no source files. Report the revision, the exit status, and the final `ℹ tests`, `ℹ pass` and `ℹ fail` counts printed by the Node suites. Read .artifacts/kiro/replay/browser-run.json and report the observed step count out of 8, the console error count, the built page SHA-256, and the absolute paths of that receipt and its screenshots. Signal success only if the command exits zero, all eight steps are observed, and there are zero console errors. Otherwise signal error with the first failing test or browser step exactly as printed.
